zoe: Quick heads-up: after landing ESM-only builds for the JS SDK, a bunch of unit tests started failing in CI. Vitest locally is green, but Jest on CI is throwing imports/mocking errors. Anyone navigated this?
dan: Yep. Common patterns: repo has "type": "module" and Jest (older pinned) runs as CJS. Errors like "Cannot use import statement outside a module" or mocks resolving to { default: [Function] } show up.
matt: Short list of fixes we've used: upgrade Jest to 29+, run jest as ESM, or keep a CJS jest config and use ts-jest/babel-jest ESM presets. Also check transforms and extensionsToTreatAsEsm.
zoe: Example error we saw: SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module at jest-runtime. Our CI image has jest 27. infra-bot, is that still pinned?
infra-bot: CI matrix for js-sdk PR-5221: node 16/18; jest pinned to 27.4.3. INFRA ticket open to bump.
dan: Mocking is subtle: if the real module exports via module.exports = fn (CJS), ESM import gets a default wrapper. Our mocks were `export const send = jest.fn()` so tests get undefined. Remedies: export default in mock, use jest.unstable_mockModule and await import, or add wrapper modules for interop.
matt: Config snippet that helped: jest.config.cjs with preset: 'ts-jest/presets/default-esm', transform for ts with { useESM: true }, and extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts', '.mts']. Also make sure package.json has exports map to choose edge vs node entry for bundlers.
zoe: For edge runtime we had an extra issue: bundlers resolved main CJS entry instead of our edge ESM entry. Adding exports mapping fixed it: e.g., "exports": { ".": { "node": "./dist/node/index.cjs", "default": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" } }.
dan: For TypeScript, split tsconfig: tsconfig.json for ESNext (vitest) and tsconfig.jest.json (module CommonJS or useESM true) for jest. Keeps both runners happy.
matt: Short-term unblock: run ESM suites under Vitest in CI for now and keep Jest for legacy CJS. Long term: bump Jest in base images and publish explicit edge/node entries.
zoe: Action items: I'll add a small README snippet with jest/vitest examples and a tiny repro under devex/sdks/js-esm-jest-repro. infra: please track Jest bump ticket.
dan: I'll contribute mock examples using jest.unstable_mockModule and a default-export mock.
infra-bot: INFRA-1012 created: bump Jest to 29.x in CI images (tracking).
zoe: Thanks all — will open the PR shortly and ping for reviews. :rocket:
